strategy_roster.name: DMI Power Move
strategy_roster.notes: DMI/+DI/-DI are unavailable; positive one-bar ROC proxies directional spread with the documented ADX 30 entry and 25 exit levels. The ATR-based stop and both-direction handling are not percentage or long-only DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Midday Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: The midday clock is unavailable, so a one-bar momentum cross against the five-bar move proxies the morning reversal. The documented 2% stop is retained; the afternoon failure and short side are not expressible in this long-only DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Seasonal Filter
strategy_roster.notes: The documented DonchianPeriod 20 breakout is retained; positive 20-bar ROC is an explicit proxy for the unavailable seasonal filter. The opposite range break exits, while ATR-based stops and intraday seasonality are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: QQQ Strategy v2 ESL easy-peasy-x
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close,sma(close,200)) and close > sma(close,100) and sma(close,200) > sma(close,100)
strategy_roster.notes: SMA 200 is the documented main MA and SMA 100 the long trend filter; alignment of the two is the explicit rising-slope proxy. The 50-bar short filter and opposite short side are omitted because this roster records long rules.

strategy_roster.name: Smoothing Average
strategy_roster.notes: The corpus supplies no MA period or smoothing value, so SMA(20) and a 2% offset are explicit research fallbacks. The offset-band cross is the long interpretation of the described smoothed-average setup; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Levels With Trail
strategy_roster.notes: A close cross above/below SMA(20) is the dynamic-level proxy because no Level Price is supplied. The documented trailing stop and price-unit stop/target cannot be represented as percentage fields; only the long breakout side is encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Flat Channel Strategy (2684)
strategy_roster.entry_long: high > donchian_high_prev(high,20) and std((high + low) / 2,20) < sma(std((high + low) / 2,20),20)
strategy_roster.notes: Median-price standard deviation below its 20-bar average proxies the flat-volatility filter, and prior 20-bar Donchian boundaries proxy the channel orders. Channel-width limits, order lifetime, and channel-relative stop/target are unsupported and have no percentage defaults.

strategy_roster.name: Williams AO + AC
strategy_roster.entry_long: bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2) > 0 and rsi(close,20) > 46 and crossabove(roc(close,1),0) and roc(close,1) > roc(close,3)
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) and RSI 20 thresholds are retained; the positive-width test is a scale-free proxy for the unavailable point band range, while ROC turns and acceleration proxy AO/AC. Session filters and point-based protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Market Master
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: The source gives indicator and risk parameters but no complete long entry formula; bullish candle momentum plus normalized volume expansion is an explicit proxy. Stochastic, MFI, SAR, ATR, pyramiding, and news controls are unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Nirvaman Imax
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and ema(close,10) > ema(close,21) and close > ema(close,13)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA 10/21/13 trend stack is translated with regular bullish candles as a Heikin-Ashi proxy. The iMAX phase detector, holding timer, no-trade hours, and price-step stop/target are not representable in the stateless long-only DSL.
